# pagetitle names the browser tab without printing a heading —
# the masthead below is this page's real title.
pagetitle: "The Chamber Monitor"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    toc: false
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r data}
#| results: asis
library(gt)
source("scripts/shared.R")

senators <- load_senators()
ns       <- senator_name_sets(senators)
bills    <- load_bills() |>
  left_join(senators |> select(name_join, District, Party), by = "name_join")
votes    <- load_all_votes(ns)
letters  <- scan_letters()
contribs <- load_all_contributions()

all_vote_rows <- if (length(votes) > 0) bind_rows(votes, .id = "source") else data.frame()

# --- The letterhead masthead + the stats ticker ----------------------------
n_votes     <- if (nrow(all_vote_rows) > 0) nrow(all_vote_rows) else 0
total_money <- if (nrow(contribs) > 0) sum(contribs$Contribution, na.rm = TRUE) else 0

cat(sprintf('
<div class="monitor-masthead">
  <div class="mast-over">The University of California, Merced</div>
  <h1 class="mast-blackletter">California State Senate</h1>
  <div class="mast-under"><span class="rule-flank">✦&nbsp;&nbsp;</span>Legislative Simulation · 2026 Session<span class="rule-flank">&nbsp;&nbsp;✦</span></div>
</div>
<div class="session-ticker"><b>%d</b> bills<span class="tick-sep">·</span><b>%d</b> votes<span class="tick-sep">·</span><b>%d</b> letters<span class="tick-sep">·</span><b>%s</b> contributed</div>
', nrow(bills), n_votes, nrow(letters), scales::dollar(total_money)))
```

```{r cards}
#| results: asis

# Helper: one monitor card. `body_html` is already-built HTML.
card <- function(label, body_html, more_href = NULL, more_text = NULL, wide = FALSE) {
  more <- if (!is.null(more_href)) {
    sprintf('<a class="card-more" href="%s">%s</a>', more_href, more_text)
  } else ""
  sprintf('<div class="monitor-card%s"><span class="card-label">%s</span>%s%s</div>',
          if (wide) " monitor-wide" else "", label, body_html, more)
}
li <- function(items) {
  if (length(items) == 0) return('<p class="wire-empty">Nothing yet.</p>')
  paste0("<ul>", paste0("<li>", items, "</li>", collapse = ""), "</ul>")
}
esc <- function(x) gsub("<", "&lt;", gsub("&", "&amp;", as.character(x)))

# --- The Wire (live via js/feed.js) ----------------------------------------
wire_card <- card(
  "The Wire",
  '<div class="wire-feed" data-limit="8"></div>',
  "news.html", "All news →"
)

# --- Floor & Committee Action: latest votes --------------------------------
action_items <- character(0)
if (nrow(all_vote_rows) > 0) {
  recent <- all_vote_rows |>
    arrange(desc(Date)) |>
    head(6) |>
    left_join(bills |> select(bill_measure, url_slug, title), by = c("Bill" = "bill_measure"))
  action_items <- sprintf(
    '<a href="%s/%s.html"><b>%s</b></a> %s · %s · %s · <span style="white-space:nowrap">%s</span>',
    BILL_PAGES_DIR, recent$url_slug, recent$Bill, esc(recent$title),
    COMMITTEE_NAMES[recent$source], recent$Vote, format(recent$Date, "%b %d")
  )
}
action_card <- card("Floor & Committee Action", li(action_items), "votes.html", "All votes →")

# --- Meetings: the latest filed agendas ------------------------------------
agenda_files <- list.files(AGENDAS_DIR, pattern = "\\.pdf$")
meeting_items <- character(0)
if (length(agenda_files) > 0) {
  ag <- data.frame(f = agenda_files) |>
    mutate(
      code = gsub("^([a-z]+)_.*$", "\\1", f),
      date = as.Date(gsub("^[a-z]+_(\\d+)_(\\d+)_(\\d+)\\.pdf$", "20\\3-\\1-\\2", f))
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(date)) |>
    head(5)
  meeting_items <- sprintf(
    '<a href="%s/%s">%s — %s</a>',
    AGENDAS_DIR, ag$f, COMMITTEE_NAMES[ag$code], format(ag$date, "%b %d")
  )
}
meetings_card <- card("Meetings", li(meeting_items), "agendas.html", "All agendas →")

# --- Letters Desk: positions filed, with org color tags --------------------
letter_items <- character(0)
if (nrow(letters) > 0) {
  lob_colors <- tryCatch(read.csv(LOBBY_CSV), error = function(e) data.frame())
  desk <- letters |>
    left_join(bills |> select(bill_number, url_slug), by = "bill_number") |>
    arrange(desc(bill_number)) |>
    head(6)
  color_of <- function(code) {
    if ("Color" %in% names(lob_colors)) {
      m <- lob_colors$Color[toupper(lob_colors$Code) == code]
      if (length(m) == 1 && !is.na(m)) return(m)
    }
    "#17345a"
  }
  letter_items <- sprintf(
    '<span class="booktab" style="--org-color:%s;display:inline-block;padding:0.05rem 0.45rem">%s</span> %s on <a href="%s/%s.html">SB-%d</a>',
    vapply(desk$org_code, color_of, character(1)),
    desk$org_code, desk$position, BILL_PAGES_DIR, desk$url_slug, desk$bill_number
  )
}
letters_card <- card("Letters Desk", li(letter_items), "lobby.html", "All lobbies →")

# --- Money Watch: latest contributions -------------------------------------
money_items <- character(0)
if (nrow(contribs) > 0) {
  mw <- contribs |>
    filter(!is.na(Recipient.District)) |>
    left_join(senators |> select(District, Last.Name, Party), by = c("Recipient.District" = "District")) |>
    arrange(desc(Date)) |>
    head(6)
  money_items <- sprintf(
    '<b>%s</b> → <a href="%s/district_%d.html">%s (%s-%d)</a> · %s · %s',
    mw$Lobby_Code, SENATOR_PAGES_DIR, mw$Recipient.District,
    esc(mw$Last.Name), mw$Party, mw$Recipient.District,
    scales::dollar(mw$Contribution), format(mw$Date, "%b %d")
  )
}
money_card <- card("Money Watch", li(money_items), "lobby.html", "All spending →")

# --- The Papers: current newspaper edition ---------------------------------
papers_html <- '<p class="wire-empty">No editions published yet.</p>'
newspaper <- read_sheet_safe(NEWSPAPER_SHEET_URL)
if (nrow(newspaper) > 0 && all(c("Edition", "Link") %in% names(newspaper))) {
  current <- newspaper |> filter(!is.na(Link) & Link != "") |> tail(1)
  if (nrow(current) == 1) {
    # The sheet's Edition column is often just a number — label it as one
    ed <- esc(current$Edition)
    if (grepl("^[0-9]+$", ed)) ed <- paste("Edition", ed)
    papers_html <- sprintf(
      '<p>Current edition: <a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><b>%s</b></a></p>',
      current$Link, ed
    )
  }
}
papers_card <- card("The Papers", papers_html, "news.html", "The newsroom →")

cat('<div class="monitor-grid">',
    wire_card, action_card, meetings_card, letters_card, money_card, papers_card,
    '</div>')
```
